Laurel Grove Capital Llc increased its stake in Store Capital Corp (STOR) by 112.84% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. The institutional investor held 31,500 shares of the real estate investment trusts company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $782,000, up from 14,800 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Laurel Grove Capital Llc who had been investing in Store Capital Corp for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $5.37 billion market cap company.
